record.issue_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:160 — EventManager is built from the caller's credentials rather than the organizer's, so when an admin or attendee adds guests the organizer's calendar event is not updated to match

adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts the mutation allows non-organizers (team admin/owner or an attendee) to add guests, but the calendar update is executed with an EventManager constructed from the *caller* (ctx.user) and their credentials: `const credentials = await getUsersCredentials(ctx.user); const eventManager = new EventManager({ ...user, credentials: [...credentials] }); await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking);`. The booking organizer is fetched separately (`organizer = prisma.user.findFirstOrThrow({ id: booking.userId })`) and the booking query even includes `user.credentials`, but those organizer credentials are not used. Therefore when someone other than the organizer triggers this, the organizer’s calendar event may not be updated (or the update may fail due to missing/incorrect credentials).
